name: Meridian Route Index
look: Four authored station marks surround shelves of blank route receipts.
search: The index distinguishes authored trunks, generated interiors, and future forks by owner and policy version.

name: Consent Workboard
look: Every work order names a requester, subject, repair boundary, and stop condition.
search: Unclassified remains stay untouched until an authored process can establish consent or safe salvage.

name: Maintenance Commons
look: A public board links every shelter pump, reed filter, and living circuit to a current steward.
search: No generated place becomes sanctuary merely because its description sounds welcoming.

name: Freeport Departure Receipts
look: The board lists only committed routes, current return signals, and the last accountable traveler.
search: Fork proposals have an empty column reserved for the future runtime capability.
